report_identity.report_title: China Display Optoelectronics Technology Holdings Limited Annual Report 2023

business_overview.one_sentence: The group sells and processes TFT LCD display modules, mainly laminated modules, with Mainland China and Hong Kong as the principal revenue regions.

segments.name: Sale of TFT LCD modules
segments.source: Annual Report 2023, Management Discussion and Analysis, revenue by product segment

segments.name: Processing TFT LCD modules
segments.source: Annual Report 2023, Management Discussion and Analysis, revenue by product segment

business_overview.revenue_model: Product sales and processing services for LCD modules, with most trade receivables on 30-90 day credit terms.
business_notes: 2023 sales volume was 47.6 million units, down 12.1% year on year.
2023 revenue was RMB2,576.8 million, down 38.8% year on year.
The new display module smart factory in Chenjiang, Huizhou commenced production during 2023.

non_recurring_items.business_substance: interest income from cash, deposits and related-party deposits; not core manufacturing profit
non_recurring_items.source: Annual Report 2023, consolidated statement of cash flows and note 34

non_recurring_items.business_substance: realised and unrealised losses on forward currency contracts recognised in profit or loss

funds_assets.business_substance: cash and bank balances available for operations; no pledged assets were disclosed
funds_assets.source: Annual Report 2023, consolidated statement of financial position and note 22

funds_assets.business_substance: non-pledged time deposits with original maturity of more than one year
deposits placed with TCL Technology, repayable within one year, unsecured, interest rates 1.05%-2.55%
funds_assets.source: Annual Report 2023, statement of financial position and note 20

funds_assets.business_substance: deposit placed with TCL Technology, repayable in the third year, unsecured, interest rate 2.85%
funds_assets.source: Annual Report 2023, statement of financial position and note 20

operating_assets.business_substance: raw materials, work in progress and finished goods for LCD module production
customer receivables and bank bills; standard credit period generally 30-90 days
factory, machinery, equipment and leasehold improvements for module production

investment_assets.business_substance: forward currency contracts measured at fair value through profit or loss

other_assets.business_substance: prepayments, deposits paid for VAT, supplier deposits and other receivables
leased land, plant/properties and equipment used in operations

financing_liabilities.business_substance: secured bank loans due within one year, related to discounted bills retained on balance sheet
operating lease liabilities for plant/properties and equipment; continuing operation item

operating_liabilities.business_substance: supplier payables, normally settled on 30-150 day terms
short-term advances from customers to deliver LCD module products

other_liabilities.business_substance: contract liabilities, salaries and welfare payables, taxes other than income tax, other payables and accruals

other_liabilities.source: Annual Report 2023, consolidated statement of financial position

years.source: Annual Report 2023 and Annual Report 2022 comparative statements

profit_cash_conversion.assessment: The three-year reported profit series is sharply down in 2023. Operating cash flow remained positive, but 2022 and 2023 free cash flow after property, plant and equipment purchases was negative. Maintenance capex is not separately disclosed; the owner-earnback analysis uses a conservative estimate near 2023 depreciation and amortisation rather than full growth capex.

evidence.source: Annual Report 2023, consolidated statement of profit or loss, RMB'000
Annual Report 2023, consolidated statement of cash flows, RMB'000
Annual Report 2023, consolidated statement of cash flows, RMB'000

gaps: The annual report does not split cash between holding company and operating subsidiaries.
The annual report does not disclose a separate maintenance capital expenditure figure.
The circular governing TCL Technology treasury deposits was not fully extracted in this run; deposit terms are based on annual report note 20.
The annual report does not disclose exact cash needed for uninterrupted operations; owner-earnback analysis estimates required operating cash conservatively.
